recomputation_shell_command:
.venv/bin/python -c 'import json; from pathlib import Path; from experiments.openexempt_online import actor_payload; from legal_skill_guard.openexempt import evaluate; from legal_skill_guard.learning.legal_namespace import decode_asset_references,decode_classification,decode_reference; from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import sha
root=Path("runs/legal_openexempt_anchored_execution_examples_TRAIN40_20261028_run01"); cfg=json.loads(Path("configs/openexempt_anchored_execution_examples_TRAIN40_20261028_run01.json").read_text()); records=json.loads((root/"paired_records.json").read_text()); pre=json.loads((root/"all_responses_before_new_grading.json").read_text())
bindings=json.loads(Path("configs/openexempt_anchored_execution_examples_TRAIN40_20261028_run01.frozen.json").read_text()); assert all(sha(p)==h for p,h in bindings["files"].items())
parent=json.loads(Path(cfg["initial_library_publication"]).read_text())["bank"]; candidate=json.loads((root/"candidate_fixed_before_new_answers.json").read_text())["bank"]; rows={(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in json.loads(Path(cfg["input_packet"]).read_text())["rows"]}
for arm,bank in (("parent",parent),("candidate",candidate)):
 assert len(pre[arm])==len(records[arm])==40 and all("score" not in r for r in pre[arm])
 assert pre[arm]==[{k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!="score"} for r in records[arm]]
 for r in records[arm]:
  row=rows[(r["case_id"],r["family"])]; raw=Path(r["raw_call_path"]); w=json.loads(raw.with_suffix(".input.json").read_text()); m,s,skills=actor_payload(row,bank,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True); assert w["messages"]==m and w["schema"]==s
  call=json.loads(raw.read_text())["calls"][0]; choice=call["response"]["choices"][0]; assert choice["finish_reason"]=="stop"; emitted=json.loads(choice["message"]["content"]); assert emitted==r["public_label_submission"]
  answer=decode_asset_references(emitted,w["public_asset_reference_catalog"])
  if row["family"]=="EC": answer=decode_classification(answer,w["public_citation_catalog"])
  else: answer={k:[{"citation":decode_reference(c["citation_ref"],w["public_citation_catalog"]),"claim_value":c["claim_value"]} for c in v] for k,v in answer.items()}
  assert r["parsed"]=={"answer":answer} and r["native_program"] is None and r["execution_receipt"] is None
  truth=json.loads((Path(cfg["grading_directory"])/str(r["case_id"])).with_suffix(".json").read_text())["targets"][r["family"]]; assert evaluate(row,answer,truth)==r["score"]
receipt=json.loads((root/"terminal_preservation.json").read_text()); assert all(sha(v["path"])==v["sha256"] for v in receipt["paths"]); assert not Path("/proc/308682").exists()
print(json.dumps({"all80_actual_wires_decoding_original_grades_verified":True,"all80_finish_stop":True,"all_new_answers_saved_before_grading":True,"frozen_files_unchanged":len(bindings["files"]),"terminal_dual_archives_verified":receipt,"original_full_proposal_adoption_still_false":not json.loads((root/"completion.json").read_text())["formal_adoption_accepted"],"new_native_teacher_grader_calls":0,"TEST_read":False}))'
